INSERT INTO architecture.projects (slug, name, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, now())
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, slug, name;

SELECT content, version, content_hash, created_at
FROM architecture.artifacts
WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'brd'
ORDER BY version DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH next_version AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v
  FROM architecture.artifacts
  WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'brd'
)
INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta)
SELECT $1, 'brd', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb
FROM next_version
RETURNING id, version;

// Build BRD.md content from validated BRD
const ctx = $('Pass Context').first().json;
const brd = $('Validate BRD').first().json.brd;

const md = [
  `# Business Requirements Document: ${ctx.projectName}`,
  '',
  '## Problem Statement',
  '',
  `### Current State\n${brd?.problemStatement?.currentState || ''}`,
  '',
  '### Pain Points',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.problemStatement?.painPoints) ? brd.problemStatement.painPoints.map(p => `- ${p}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  `### Impact\n${brd?.problemStatement?.impact || ''}`,
  '',
  '## Business Objectives',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.businessObjectives) ? brd.businessObjectives.map(o => `- ${o}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Success Metrics (KPIs)',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.successCriteria) ? brd.successCriteria.map(s => `- ${s}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Stakeholders',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.stakeholders) ? brd.stakeholders.map(s => `- ${typeof s === 'string' ? s : JSON.stringify(s)}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Constraints & Assumptions',
  '### Constraints',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.constraints) ? brd.constraints.map(c => `- ${c}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '### Assumptions',
  ...(Array.isArray(brd?.assumptions) ? brd.assumptions.map(a => `- ${a}`) : ['-']),
  '',
  '## Scope',
  '',
  `### In Scope\n${(brd?.scope && brd.scope.inScope) ? brd.scope.inScope : ''}`,
  '',
  '### Features',
  ...(((brd?.scope && Array.isArray(brd.scope.features)) ? brd.scope.features : []).map(f => `- ${f}`) || ['-']),
  '',
  '### Out of Scope',
  ...(((brd?.scope && Array.isArray(brd.scope.outOfScope)) ? brd.scope.outOfScope : []).map(f => `- ${f}`) || ['-']),
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { ...ctx, brdMarkdown: md, brd } }];
